subject: Music
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced theories and principles of music
entries.specific_competence: 1.1   Demonstrate an understanding of the fundamentals of music theory
entries.learning_activity: Describe the fundamentals of reading and writing music based on ABRSM Music Theory Grade VI (Rhythm, and melody and harmony)
teaching_learning_activities: Flash Cards: Handle out flashcards of questions and problems concerning reading and writing music based on what is covered in ABRSM Music Theory Grade VI
Case Study: Guide students to explore known written music based on what is covered in ABRSM Music Theory Grade VI
Problem-based learning: Provide students with erroneous musical pieces for them to detect the errors and write a review.
entries.assessment: Fundamentals of reading and writing music based on ABRSM Music Theory Grade VI are explained correctly
entries.references: TIE, Music for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.specific_competence: 2.3    Play local and foreign musical instruments
entries.learning_activity: (b) Use local and foreign musical instruments (strings, percussion and wind) to accompany contemporary songs in an ensemble
